title: gateway recipient store: no test for the (newer state, stale floor) heal branch nor same-highest window-bit rollback
description: Found by 3x codereview of the recipient-store heal (9liz). Both gateway tests simulate the crash by DELETING the floor (gateway.rs:1996-2001, 2044), but with state-then-floor write ordering and atomic FileStorage writes, the realistic crash artifact for accept N>1 is a floor present but stale at N-1 - handled by the state != floor rewrite arm (~469-472), exercised by no gateway test. Same-highest/fewer-window-bit rollback detection (the reason the heal must copy the full 13-byte state, not just highest; precedes() third clause ~426-432) is also untested. The announce store pins exactly this (store_rejects_state_rollback_and_heals_floor_lag, announce_store.rs:666-686). Implementation appears correct by inspection; add the missing test to pin the contract. Mirror the announce store test.
